description: This is a PHP test class for the AuthProviderDao component within the OrangeHRM's OpenID Authentication plugin. It contains unit tests for various methods including fetching, creating, and deleting authentication provider data, focusing on the DAO layer.

classes.name: AuthProviderDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the AuthProviderDao in the context of OrangeHRM's OpenID plugin, verifying CRUD operations and data retrieval methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data using fixture YAML file before each test.

methods.name: testGetAuthProviderById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an auth provider by ID and validates its properties.

methods.name: testGetAuthProviderDetailsByProviderId
methods.description: Tests fetching detailed auth provider info by provider ID.

methods.name: testGetAuthProviders
methods.description: Tests fetching a list of auth providers with pagination.

methods.name: testGetAuthProviderCount
methods.description: Tests counting auth providers matching filter criteria.

methods.name: testDeleteProviders
methods.description: Tests soft deletion of providers by setting status false.

methods.name: testSaveProvider
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new OpenIdProvider entity.

methods.name: testSaveAuthProviderExtraDetails
methods.description: Tests saving extra details for an auth provider.

methods.name: testGetAuthProvidersForLoginPage
methods.description: Tests retrieving auth providers suitable for login page display.
